objective: Replace the static resume skills bar visualization in src/routes/resume/+page.svelte with an interactive Chart.js-based chart explorer. Users must be able to switch among multiple chart types (horizontal/vertical bar, pie, doughnut, polar area, bubble, radar, and at least one additional distribution chart) and filter skills by tech stack, category, proficiency tier, and years of experience. Add yearsOfExperience as a new numeric field on SkillRecord in src/lib/content/skills.ts and populate all skill records with reasonable values. Preserve prerendered resume content for no-JS baseline (skills list or summary remains in HTML); chart interactivity is a progressive enhancement. Reuse chart.js ^4.5.1 already in package.json. Follow active ADRs (002, 003, 004, 006, 007, 008, 011).
